title: Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.29232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. translated_title: 面向类别无关检测的无背景目标性学习
translated_abstract: 目标检测器通常在闭集监督下训练，其中未标注区域被隐式地视为背景。在不完整标注的情况下，这一假设会引入目标性偏差：视觉上有效但未被标注的物体被当作负样本使用，从而使目标性与标注的分类体系绑定在一起，而非与通用的物体结构相关联。这一局限性对类别无关检测和开放世界检测来说尤为成问题。本文提出了无背景目标性学习，这是一种密集的类别无关检测框架，能够在未标注区域上无需显式背景监督即可学习目标性。B-FOR将检测表述为对密集多尺度物体中心场和尺度场的预测，物体假设由此作为局部空间结构自然涌现。监督通过空间结构化的软目标仅施加于可靠的标注区域，从而避免了前景-背景判别。为支持解……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出无背景目标性学习框架B-FOR，通过预测密集多尺度物体中心与尺度场、并仅在可靠标注区域施加软目标监督，摆脱了将未标注区域视为背景所带来的目标性偏差，从而在不完整标注条件下实现类别无关的通用目标检测。
en_tdlr: B-FOR is a background-free objectness learning framework that predicts dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields with supervision confined to reliable annotated regions, eliminating objectness bias caused by treating unlabeled regions as background and enabling robust class-agnostic detection under incomplete annotations.
